adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 repair parsed Table 1 into row-level MIC records, added primary toxicity rows, reconciled linked DBAASP/APD6/CAMP database records, and closed the prior worker-6 framework-test rework ticket while preserving database-scope and bounded-mechanism cautions.

paper_xml.coverage: article metadata, abstract, methods, results, XML Table 1, Table 2, figure captions, antimicrobial, toxicity, LPS neutralization, and mechanism sections

paper_pdf.coverage: pdftotext-derived article text cross-check for Table 1 values, toxicity result text, mechanism result text, and supplementary-material note

oa_package.coverage: PMC package NXML/PDF, figure files, and supplementary DOC member checked as the source package backing local XML/PDF assets

supplementary_assets.coverage: Supplement DOC contains primer sequences only; landed .bin files are HTML landing pages; no supplementary activity/toxicity table changes the final layer.

merged_database_rows.coverage: DBAASP assay rows plus APD6/CAMP literature/experiment summary rows reconciled against primary sequence, activity, toxicity, mechanism, DOI/PMID/PMCID traceability.

per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_2_activity_toxicity: Primary XML Table 1 was re-parsed as nine MIC records with target/entity/value/unit/locator fields; primary result text added hemolysis and macrophage cytotoxicity records with concentration context.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_4_database: DBAASP assay rows were matched to repaired primary rows; APD6/CAMP broad free-text rows are preserved as source_conflict because they are not row-level assay evidence even though identity/citation are source-supported.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_adjudication: The open framework-test ticket is resolved after source-reviewed repair; final status is accepted_with_cautions, not accepted_clean, because database-scope and mechanism-boundary cautions remain scientifically relevant.

caution_findings.record: APD6:AP02901 and CAMP:CAMPSQ10537 free-text linked rows
caution_findings.note: APD6/CAMP rows summarize sequence, antimicrobial activity, cytotoxicity, anti-inflammatory activity, and mechanism in broad text fields. Final curation keeps row-level primary evidence separate and preserves those database rows as source_conflict for scope normalization.

DBAASP uses an expanded Salmonella taxonomy label while primary Table 1 uses the shorter Salmonella paratyphi A ATCC 9150 label; the ATCC-linked target/value match is preserved with a nomenclature note.

caution_findings.record: MOESM1 DOC and landed supplementary .bin assets
caution_findings.note: The DOC supplement contains primer sequences only and the landed .bin files are HTML landing pages; no activity/toxicity value was fabricated from supplementary placeholders.

caution_findings.record: SEM, macrophage inflammatory-response assays, and LAL assay
caution_findings.note: Membrane disruption, macrophage pathway suppression, and partial LPS neutralization are source-supported; no single molecular receptor target or in vivo sepsis efficacy claim is promoted.
Blocking rework is closed and gates can pass, but database-scope and bounded-mechanism cautions remain visible.
